scope: CHARLS unique son child minus remaining children contact by baseline education
sequence: Only individually passing CC families and admitted fresh MI. MI01 A/B check then MI02-20. Any failed member stops its family; never pool successful subset.
starts: A uses accepted CC A high-precision estimates; MI01 B adds deterministic +/-0.02 CC SE to means, loadings and regression starts, retaining positive variances. Remaining imputations use same CC A starts; no previous-imputation solution substituted.

inference.primary: Joint D1 of IZ->IY, IZ->SY, SZ->SY resource differences
inference.secondary: Joint X-path differences and joint six-path diagnostic; group-specific paths with full covariance
inference.multiplicity: Holm across planned 4 indicators x3 resources =12 for each separately labelled test set, including unrun income in denominator

boundaries: 20 control-imputed datasets do not establish exact latent-model congeniality or MAR. H4.1 coverage is distinct from four latent moderations/H4.2 and CFPS. Income remains separate.
budget_timebase: Verified active_seconds where recorded; otherwise original exit_confirmed_seconds retained conservatively. Total cap unchanged.
